suite: Area queue, live rates and modifier box selection
host: Offline UI using production worker/view/pointer controller, not React main entry

cases.name: DPR1: all queue descending by real area, not ID
DPR1: multi-select preserves explicit set but sorts playback by area
DPR1: unmodified real pointer drag selects island only
DPR1: Shift drag adds island and queue remains area ordered
DPR1: Alt drag inverses selected island; second use restores it
DPR1: Ctrl drag subtracts without touching others
DPR1: box can cover many islands in one transaction
DPR1: Escape cancels live box without modifying selection
DPR1: backwards drag works; hit triangle not box direction
DPR1: speed choices include slow and very fast
DPR1: changing speed keeps camera, progress, mesh and timeline identities
DPR1: wall-time status changes with multiplier
DPR1: live playback does not pause when rate changes
DPR1: high speed can complete without tail delay
DPR1: default focus and automatic overlap enabled with no camera follow
DPR1: no WebGL or uncaught JS errors
